Two merged pull requests on the main line since 2026-04-14 added or removed a line containing `ThreadLocal` under `api/src/main/java/org/openmrs/api`. Both are confirmed from the PR records and the diffs.

1. **PR #6544** (TRUNK-6799, "Introduce Spring Security with support for legacy authentication context"), merged 2026-10-08 (13:44:46 UTC, merge commit `a69b14a8`). It removed the `ThreadLocal<Object[]>` holder and its comment from `openmrs-core/api/src/main/java/org/openmrs/api/context/Context.java`, and added `ThreadLocal<UserContext> userContextHolder`, which is now at `Context.java:162`.
2. **PR #6588** (TRUNK-6721, "Replace StackWalker with a thread-local guard"), merged 2026-09-21 (20:28:22 UTC, merge commit `f10e3fb9`). It added `private static final ThreadLocal<Integer> DEPTH` in `openmrs-core/api/src/main/java/org/openmrs/api/impl/UserServiceImpl.java:111`, inside `UserPasswordGuard`.

The current tree has 11 `ThreadLocal` matches under that path. The ones in `Daemon.java`, `ImmutableEntityInterceptor.java` and `UserContext`/`Context` were not added or removed in the window, so they are not counted.

Coverage is incomplete. I checked the diffs of about 20 of the 44 main-line commits that touch that path since 2026-04-14. I ruled out the Daemon, UserContext, ChainingInterceptor, HandlerUtil, GZIP, JobRunr, search and concept-DAO commits. Several commits remain unchecked, or only partly checked: `1b5421a9` (role-privilege cache; its large diff could not be read), `07e8ea06` (global property caching), `5eb8cba2`, `2ce84774`, `9e011e2c`, `4d222c60`, and `b147e0dc`. I could not check these within the search and read limits, so a third match is possible.
